name: FindMyPart Paid Part Hunt
problem: A difficult, identified-enough physical part is still blocking a repair, restoration, machine or project after ordinary sourcing has failed or deeper cross-reference, salvage, documentation, blueprint or fabrication work is needed.
use_when: find a supersession or cross reference
find a donor or salvage part
find a blueprint or fabrication path
source new old stock or aftermarket replacement
normal part searches failed and I need deeper sourcing
inputs: Part description plus any known equipment identity, model/serial/part numbers, photos, measurements or functional clues.
outputs: Evidence-backed paid sourcing hunt with tier-dependent source lanes, customer-safe Part Passport state, candidate source evidence, verification state, and escalation paths when ordinary sourcing fails.
pricing: Quick Hunt $19 one-time; Deep Hunt $49 one-time; Rescue Hunt $99 one-time.
confirmation: User must explicitly choose an offer and confirm payment. Paid fulfillment starts only after independently verified payment.
payment_authority: Evercraft Payments with Stripe provider verification
invocation_status: LIVE: direct FindMyPart MCP exposes free Part Passport triage, current paid offers, human-confirmed checkout preparation, and private-token hunt status. Use free_part_triage first when identity or sourcing path is unclear. Paid fulfillment still requires authoritative provider verification.
authority_rule: Discovery never creates a payment obligation. Checkout preparation requires explicit human confirmation when supported. Checkout creation is not proof of payment. Paid state and fulfillment require authoritative provider verification.
